panels.description: Current stale target entries and absent entries for the selected catalog locale, excluding each owning source locale. Missing can be intentional and is informational only: it is not required locale coverage, a failure, or an alert condition.

targets.rawSql:
WITH translation_entries(entity_type, entity_id, locale, status) AS (
  SELECT 'post', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM post_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'page', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM page_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'work', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM work_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'program_event', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM program_event_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'release', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM release_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'artist', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM artist_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'label', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM label_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'menu', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM menu_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'email_template', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM email_template_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'email_layout', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM email_layout_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM campaign_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'form', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM form_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'privacy', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM privacy_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'terms', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM terms_translation
  UNION ALL SELECT 'series', entity_id::text, locale, status FROM series_translation
), stale_counts AS (
  SELECT entry.entity_type, COUNT(*) AS stale_entries
  FROM translation_entries entry
  JOIN translation_source_state source
    ON source.entity_type = entry.entity_type
   AND source.entity_id::text = entry.entity_id
  WHERE entry.locale <> source.source_locale
    AND entry.status = 'stale'
    AND entry.entity_type IN (${entity_type:sqlstring})
    AND entry.locale IN (${target_locale:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY entry.entity_type
), missing_counts AS (
  SELECT source.entity_type, COUNT(*) AS missing_entries
  FROM translation_source_state source
  JOIN translation_locale locale
    ON locale.code <> source.source_locale
   AND locale.code IN (${target_locale:sqlstring})
  WHERE source.entity_type IN (${entity_type:sqlstring})
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM translation_entries entry
      WHERE entry.entity_type = source.entity_type
        AND entry.entity_id = source.entity_id
        AND entry.locale = locale.code
    )
  GROUP BY source.entity_type
), entity_types AS (
  SELECT entity_type FROM stale_counts
  UNION
  SELECT entity_type FROM missing_counts
)
SELECT entity_types.entity_type AS "Entity type",
       COALESCE(stale_counts.stale_entries, 0) AS "Stale entries",
       COALESCE(missing_counts.missing_entries, 0) AS "Missing entries (informational)"
FROM entity_types
LEFT JOIN stale_counts USING (entity_type)
LEFT JOIN missing_counts USING (entity_type)
ORDER BY "Stale entries" DESC, "Missing entries (informational)" DESC, entity_types.entity_type ASC;
